card.name: Size comparisons to familiar things
card.fires_on: Small linking words (a, of, to, large) right after phrases like 'as tall as' or 'equivalent to' that compare a big quantity to a familiar object. Seen in science and news text about huge sizes or amounts.

modes.label: Article after 'as tall as'
modes.description: The word 'a' or a gap before a number, introducing a familiar object used to show scale.
modes.example: stands as tall as<< a>> 9-story building.

modes.label: Linking word in 'equivalent to' comparisons
modes.description: 'of', 'to' or 'single' inside a phrase equating a quantity with a flow, power or emissions figure.
modes.example: which is equivalent to the flow of a<< large>> river.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are mostly Chinese words for leadership groups and collectives, so the output effect is unclear.
card.plain: It fires on the little words that lead into a 'this is as big as a ...' comparison.
